_comment: CCV-L23's cross-module loops of ooe_rename (OA 481-501): u_go.pl (OA-494), u_gfree's section allocations sa_v/sa_row/sa_sec (OA-498) and returns rt_v/rt_row (OA-501), each signed by OA in the register.

u_go.pl_cq02h.why: the go's lagged take (OA-490, OI-207, OA-489, OA-494): u_go grants lanes at 02 (lane_v_cq02h, lane_c_cq02h); they cross u_ren1, a register-free helper, combinationally into l_v, whose per-class takes the parent counts into pl_cq03h; u_go's pool correction reads it a cycle later as its pl at 02. u_go.wt_cq02h is no register: ooe_go's always_comb sums wtq_cq02h, combinational on pl; it is listed as it reads pl, and it feeds the free lists' alloc_req, not the takes. A stale take over-grants names, RS rows or a slot's room.

u_gfree.sa_v_cq01h.why: u_gfree's section state (OI-81/82): Rename 2's section allocations leave u_ren1n at 03 and reach the free list's write at its 01 two cycles after the candidates they consumed left it at 02; the free list's candidates and avail are read ahead of them by design, its pend/wr masks covering the two in-flight cycles. A late allocation leaves a section free in its state that is not: sec_free_live and sec_alloc_free catch it (control sa-late).

u_gfree.rt_v_cq01h.why: u_gfree's returns (OI-81/82): Rename 2 returns a granted row it did not use; the return leaves u_ren1n at 03 and reaches the free list's pending register at its 01 two cycles after the grant left it at 02, the edge after the grant. A late return names a row granted two edges back: rt_of_grant (the grants a cycle older, check-only) catches it (control rt-late).
